changelog:
Version 7.8.63

Improvements

  • Third-party widgets load when visitors need them. On the Turbo++ and Maximum presets, embedded third-party widgets (forms, chat, booking and review tools) now load on the visitor's first interaction, or after a few seconds, instead of competing with the page during loading. This greatly reduces Total Blocking Time on pages with heavy embeds. Libraries that other scripts rely on (maps, video players, captcha), consent tools, analytics and payment scripts are never delayed. Existing sites get this after re-applying the Turbo++ or Maximum preset.
  • An image preload that no longer matches the page's hero image is now removed automatically, so phones no longer download an outdated hero image.

Fixes

  • Mobile menus: a tap on a menu button made while the page was still loading is no longer lost when the button uses an SVG icon.
  • A script marked nomodule no longer blocks the other delayed scripts from running.
  • Delayed third-party scripts that wait for the page load event now run correctly.
  • Deferred stylesheets keep their own media query (for example WooCommerce's small-screen stylesheet now stays mobile-only).
  • Saving a draft, a private post or a store order no longer clears the home page cache.
  • "Purge page cache" no longer re-enables a page cache you had turned off.
  • Pages that set DONOTCACHEPAGE are no longer cached; links carrying ?ref= or ?source= are no longer served from cache.
  • Background cache prewarm skips a page that keeps failing instead of pausing all prewarming.
  • Manually entered critical CSS keeps quotation marks intact.
  • Escaped class names (for example Tailwind's md:flex) are no longer treated as unused CSS.
  • Lazy-loaded background images now apply to every repeated element, including loop grids and carousel slides.
  • The icon font is only subset when every icon on the page can be identified.
  • The optional "Accelerator mode" script delay now loads core scripts correctly.
  • Protection against blank output when the server's regular-expression limits are reached on very large pages.

Admin and security

  • A build that fails validation is no longer written to a publicly readable file.
  • Applying settings works on hosts that run PHP-FPM.
  • wp-config.php and .htaccess are only rewritten when a change is needed, and never when the file cannot be read.
  • The Advisor recommendations display again.
  • "Skip specific pages" accepts paths with a trailing slash (for example /contact/).
  • Saved lists keep quotation marks correctly.
